lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal peduncle; pixel maxima are concentrated in an grid-like arrangement with approximately 4-6 blobs per horizontal segment between the gills and dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows at near-90 degree angles, forming discrete anchor nodes most visible on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient (light-to-shadow transition) running parallel across the mid and upper flank, extending from the fifth gill slit to the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-intensity high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily at the anterior base and along the leading edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal edge and dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin exhibit a high-density population of small, uniform high-luminance spots distinct from the larger lateral flank clusters.
